title: ヨキッチ、ブーイングのファンに「来なくていい」　ナゲッツが23点差から逆転勝ち
title_zh: 约基奇对嘘声球迷说“别来了”，掘金从落后23分逆转取胜

image.credit: Photo by Weigler Godoy on Unsplash
image.author: Weigler Godoy

lead: アメリカのプロバスケットボール、NBAで、デンバー・ナゲッツがニューオーリンズ・ペリカンズに勝ちました。23点も負けていましたが、最後に逆転しました。
lead_zh: 在美国职业篮球NBA中，丹佛掘金队战胜了新奥尔良鹈鹕队。他们一度落后23分，但最后完成了逆转。
preview: 土曜日の試合で、ナゲッツは141対135でペリカンズに勝ちました。延長戦の末の勝利でした。ヨキッチ選手は35点を取り、15リバウンド、10アシストも記録しました。
preview_zh: 在周六的比赛中，掘金队以141比135战胜鹈鹕队。这是一场经过加时赛的胜利。约基奇得到35分，还拿下15个篮板和10次助攻。
paragraphs: 土曜日の試合で、ナゲッツは141対135でペリカンズに勝ちました。延長戦の末の勝利でした。ヨキッチ選手は35点を取り、15リバウンド、10アシストも記録しました。
前半、ナゲッツは57対73と負けていました。会場のファンの一部がチームにブーイングをしました。試合の後、ヨキッチ選手は「ブーイングしたファンはもう来なくていい」と話しました。
マレー選手は42点を取りました。

上半场，掘金以57比73落后。现场部分球迷对球队发出了嘘声。赛后，约基奇说：“嘘我们的球迷以后不用来了。”
穆雷得到42分。新秀布拉齐尔在加时赛中也有出色表现。掘金队伤病很多，这场比赛打得很艰难。

body_original:
Jokić says booing fans ‘not welcome’ after Nuggets rally from 23 points down to beat Pelicans
New Orleans Pelicans 135-141 Denver Nuggets (OT)
Nuggets fans showed displeasure at half-time
Nikola Jokić scored eight of his 35 points in overtime and finished with 15 rebounds and 10 assists, and the short-handed Denver Nuggets rallied from 23 points down to beat the New Orleans Pelicans 141-135 on Saturday night.
Jokić had his 199th career triple-double in the regular season, second to Russell Westbrook, who retired with 209.
Sections of the Nuggets home crowd booed the team when they went into half-time 73-57 down. After the game, Jokić made his displeasure clear.
“We got booed at our first home game, and I think those fans who booed us, they don’t need to come anymore,” Jokić said. “If you guys follow us, you know that we never quit and we’ve come back from much worse situations. So, if they ask me, they are not welcome anymore.”
Jamal Murray scored 42 points and rookie Trevon Brazille had seven of his 17 points in overtime in his home debut for Denver, which took an early lead in overtime. His corner three-pointer with 1:25 left in overtime gave the Nuggets a 133-129 lead.
Denver played without Cam Johnson (ankle) and Alpha Diallo (sprained wrist) and continued to be without Julian Strawther and Spencer Jones.
Trey Murphy III led New Orleans with 26 points, Dejounte Murray had 22 points and Derik Queen and Zion Williamson scored 17 each. The Pelicans have dropped their first three games under first-year coach Jamahl Mosley.
New Orleans shot 65.9% in the first half and led by 23. Denver rallied to cut it to 16, and Jokić and Murray combined to score 22 of the Nuggets’ 32 points in the third quarter but the Pelicans extended the lead to 19 heading into the fourth.
Denver erased the deficit on three-pointers from Murray and Jokić, a reverse dunk from Aaron Gordon, and then had a chance to go ahead with 17 seconds left but Murray made two of three free throws to tie it.
